summary: This topic covers the login process for the ERP system using a phone number and OTP, and provides an overview of the dashboard interface, including company/entity name display, user ID, session information, and the permission-based menu structure.
steps: Log in using your registered phone number and the One-Time Password (OTP) received.
Optionally, you can set a password for future logins.
Upon successful login, the dashboard will appear, displaying your company/entity name, user ID, and current session details.
business_rules: Login is primarily via phone number and OTP.
Menu options displayed are based on user permissions.
important_notes: The URL (campus.audipay.org) can be saved or attached to your homescreen for easy access.
The dashboard interface is personalized, showing your institute's name and your user ID.
The system supports multiple sessions, which can be searched.
